verdict.rationale: Agent Studio is Algolia's own feature for this story. It connects an LLM to Algolia search and grounds responses in live index data, and it supports conversational search and shopping assistants that answer questions. The Search API provides documented retrieval over indices, and the Crawler can build RAG-optimized indexes. However, the evidence never documents a programmatic answer/completions API endpoint, and there is no hands-on corroboration that RAG works. missing for 10: a documented answer/chat API reference for Agent Studio (endpoints, request/response, streaming), developer integration examples for RAG over custom indexes, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can power RAG and conversational answers on top of my indexes with documented retrieval or answer APIs

citations.quote: Agent Studio connects your chosen LLM to Algolia search and tools. It manages the end-to-end workflow and grounds responses in live data from your Algolia indices.
The Algolia Search API lets you search, configure, and manage your indices and records
Crawl web pages or whole sites into a RAG-optimized index with the Algolia Crawler
